headline: The Election Commission of Pakistan on Wednesday ordered local government elections in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa districts where delimitation is complete, excluding 12 districts under special emergency arrangements.

card.desc: Polls to be held where delimitation is complete.

caption:
The Election Commission of Pakistan has ordered local government elections in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa districts where delimitation is complete, Dawn reports. Twelve districts under special emergency arrangements are excluded for now, Geo News adds.
